_om: Julekalenderen in English (Advent Calendar, rusj.no/en/advent-calendar/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A «luke» is a door, «pynt» a bauble on the shared tree, «dagens nisse» today's elf (the host who reads aloud). The 24 doors are in data.en/luker.json, written for a British December. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Kos, lek og prat for store og små: Cosy things, games and chats for all ages
På storskjerm – og ingenting privat: On the big screen – nothing personal
Velg en som leser høyt og leder i dag. B: Pick someone to read aloud and lead today. Children can lead too!

et rusj-spill med juletvist: a rusj game with a festive twist
Fra 1. desember åpner dere én luke hver: From 1 December you open one door a day. The phone hosts – the rest happens between you.
Hver luke dere gjør, henger en ny pynt p: Every door you do hangs a new bauble on your tree. By Christmas Eve it's finished!
Tenk sammen. Den som tror den vet det, h: Think together. Whoever thinks they know whispers the answer to today's elf.
Tell til tre – så viser alle svaret med: Count to three – then everyone shows their answer on their fingers at once: 1, 2 or 3!
For en gjeng! Dere har fulgt med hele de: What a crew! You've been paying attention all December.
Godt jobba – og nå vet dere enda mer om: Well done – and now you know even more about Christmas.
Talk it over and agree on one answer.
Spillet åpner her på mobilen. Trykk tilb: The game opens here on the phone. Tap back when you've finished – the door will wait.
Hele treet er pyntet! God jul!: The whole tree is decorated! Merry Christmas!
Stjerna er på plass. God jul!: The star is on top. Merry Christmas!
Pynten henger på treet. {n} av 24!: The bauble is on the tree. {n} of 24!
Har dere gjort luka sammen? Da får treet: Have you done the door together? Then the tree gets a new bauble.
Del luka, så kan andre åpne den sammen d: Share the door, so others can open it together too.
Julekort til praten: A Christmas card to chat about
Dagens nisse leser høyt. Alle som vil, s: Today's elf reads it aloud. Anyone who wants to answers – and the others listen. It's always fine to pass.
24 stunder sammen – kos, prat og spill: 24 moments together – cosy things, chats and games

An Advent calendar for doing things together. Behind every door are 5–15 minutes of something cosy, a chat and a game – for the family, your friends or the class.
Family, friends, or class and work. Add your names, and each day one of you is today's elf, who reads aloud and leads.
Gjør kos-ideen sammen, snakk om julekort: Do the cosy idea together, chat about the Christmas card, guess together and play today's rusj game. The phone hosts – the rest happens between you.
Hver luke dere gjør, gir en ny pynt på j: Every door you do adds a new bauble to your tree. By Christmas Eve the tree is finished – and you can download it or print it.
Barn kan godt være dagens nisse. De voks: Children make great elves. The grown-ups help with the reading.
Skriv ut papirkalenderen: Hver luke har: Print the paper calendar: every door has a QR code that opens that very door.
«Legg til påminnelse» gir en påminnelse: ‘Add a reminder’ puts a reminder in your calendar at 6 pm every day. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Har dere glemt en dag? Tidligere luker k: Missed a day? Earlier doors can be opened all through December.
Kalenderen husker lukene og treet på den: The calendar remembers your doors and your tree on this phone.
Takk for alle stundene sammen i desember: Thank you for all the moments together in December. The doors stay open a little longer – why not do a favourite again?
Fornavn eller gruppenavn – eller ingenti: First names or group names – or none at all. The names stay on this device.
Én av dere er dagens nisse hver dag: les: Each day one of you is today's elf: reads aloud and leads. Children can lead too!
The tree is waiting for its first bauble.
Bildet lages her på mobilen. Ingen navn: The picture is made here on the phone. No names are on it.
Skriv ut på A4 og heng den på kjøleskape: Print it on A4 and put it on the fridge or in the classroom. Every door has a QR code that opens that very door.
